annotations.title: Update account name, company name or retention

description: Change the account holder's name, the company name, or how long document contents are kept. Recipients see emails from "<company name> via md2sign", or the person's own name when there is no company name, so fix these before sending if they are wrong. Only the company admin can change the company name or content_retention_days; an empty company_name removes it. Shortening content_retention_days deletes the contents of documents already past the new period within a day, so confirm with your human first.

api_key.description: An md2sign API key. When given, this call uses that key's account even if the connection is signed in as someone else, so pass it on every call when your human has more than one md2sign account (for example two businesses). Also use it if your MCP client cannot send an "Authorization: Bearer <api_key>" header.

company_name.description: The business name recipients see, e.g. "Law Garden Design". Pass an empty string to remove it and use the person's own name.

content_retention_days.description: Days after a document is completed, declined, voided or expired that md2sign keeps its contents (markdown and message) before deleting them. Signatures, the seal and the audit trail are kept, so documents stay verifiable. Default 90.

name.description: The account holder's full name, as they want it shown to recipients.

name: update_account
